clauses.text: 1. Purpose and Scope of the Post-Project Review

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose and Scope of the Post-Project Review

clauses.text: This Post-Project Review (PPR) is executed to conduct an exhaustive assessment of the electronic hardware deployment project undertaken by Primevolta Hardware Solutions for FinSecure Services. The review’s primary purpose is to evaluate the project against all contractual, operational, technical, and financial parameters established in the Master Supply and Services Agreement dated [Agreement Date]. This PPR aims to provide a formal record of project outcomes, identify any variances from agreed specifications, review the effectiveness of project governance mechanisms, and provide actionable recommendations for future projects. The scope encompasses hardware performance, installation quality, technical support effectiveness, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation measures, financial reconciliation, and client satisfaction assessment.
